comment: Read from src/ResetHelper at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Reset Helper, which matches the code. Four more inputs are declared than the panel carries: ResetHelper.hpp:38 reserves twice the input count while only four are given jacks, so inputs 4 to 7 have no census position and no click can reach them; nothing reads them either. The line that configures the input names is written out twice in the loop (ResetHelper.cpp:36 and 37), which is harmless. The merge window is raised to the trigger length whenever it is shorter (ResetHelper.cpp:52), so the 0ms end of the knob still gives a window as long as the trigger.
